d:
Bihar men navanbar ke aakhiri dinon men mausam ka mijaj philhal sthir bana huaa hai. subah thand aur kohre ka asar dikh raha hai, jabki din charhne ke sath mausam thora rahat dene vala rahega. mausam vibhag ke mutabik, 28 navanbar ko rajyabhar men mausam shushk rahne vala hai. na barish ka alart hai aur na hi kisi bare mausmi badlav ki sanbhavna.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
